verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents exporting finished videos as .mp4 through time-limited API download links, and its pricing page lists SCORM export, so rendered outputs can leave the platform in open formats. Nothing shows a way to export *all* of a user's data, such as projects, scripts, avatars, brand kits, voice clones, or interactive/quiz data, or any account-wide export or offboarding process. missing for 10: full account/workspace data export, export of editable project and source data in open formats, documented exit/portability process, independent or hands-on corroboration.
